headline: MI300X leads price-performance at $2.64 per PFLOP-hour while hyperscalers stay far above neocloud pricing.
bullets: MI300X has the best price-performance at $2.64 per PFLOP-hour, and RunPod Community Cloud lists it at $0.50 against a $3.45 market index, though only 5 providers offer it.
H200 carries a +124% hyperscaler premium, with a $10.30 hyperscaler median versus a $4.59 neocloud median and $3.59 at RunPod Community Cloud.
B200 sets the top of the market at a $7.81 index, with hyperscalers at $14.12 versus $6.84 for neoclouds (+106%) and $3.47 per PFLOP-hour.
H100 SXM is offered by all 12 providers at a $4.32 index, with a $2.50 marketplace median and $2.31 at Vast.ai versus $10.68 at hyperscalers.
A100 80GB SXM looks cheap at a $2.70 index but is the costliest per unit of compute at $8.65 per PFLOP-hour.
watch: Seven-day change figures are not yet populated for any GPU, so watch for the first trend readings to confirm whether hyperscaler premiums are holding.
